bins: [a,b); below 0 and at least 150 are explicit open tail classes; no GDI clipping
base_models: For each outer f, reuse four fixed-terminal CNN/STT pairs trained excluding BOTH f and inner j
meta_partition: Only base-held-out inner j people; deterministic 60% train,20% select,remainder probability calibration; person IDs shuffled with seed 20261031+100*f+j
after_selection: Refit head and its standardizer on train+select; calibrate only on disjoint calibration people; never refit using calibration people
heads: Fixed-boundary ordinal logistic location-scale; score_only learns location from first3 features and constant scale; score_spread learns location from7 and scale from4 spread features
selection_metric: person-equal negative log likelihood; ties follow family/grid order
calibration: Temperature scaling of log probabilities; T in [0.25,4], person-equal NLL on calibration-only people
probability_baseline: Fixed-half point score plus a single logistic residual scale fitted on meta train+select, then same disjoint temperature calibration
ensemble: Equal average of four experts per outer fold; no outer labels used for weights or post-ensemble calibration
metrics: ranked probability score normalized by K-1
weighting: equal people; equal records within person; equal left/right within record
limitations: Development cohort already explored, not independent final validation
Four inner base models differ from original outer-refit pipeline; include matched-model baseline
Each head uses about110 people for refit and about28 people for calibration
Independent expert calibration does not guarantee calibration after averaging
No claim of transfer reliability on unlabelled external adults
